propositions: Current clarity measure awards points for generic volume (headings, char count, bullets) and type-specific bonuses without enforcing author-guide leaf/container contract, permitting padded tickets to pass without required Scope, Approach, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity score logic is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py with inconsistent bug-branch handling, creating drift risk on any future extension.

Documented plan-writing guidance specifies required sections (Context/Problem, Approach, AC with verification proving) and placeholder-free executable scope, but current deterministic checks do not enforce these shapes structurally.

Per-AC verification coverage cannot be reliably determined without parsing checkbox items for operator attestation or explicit proving clauses (verified by, checked by, verify with), which the current measure does not detect.

Author guide requests rejected-alternative wording while authoritative G6 criteria do not, creating conflicting signals that must be resolved before encoding rejected-alternative text as a deterministic check.
